Codex v1 users added the marketplace with no ref, and Codex reads .agents/plugins/marketplace.json first, whose source is "./" on main. `codex plugin marketplace upgrade` (line 41) keeps them on main forever, and once main gets the v2 source (line 17) they receive a source tree, not the release build.
findings.evidence: Live: `codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode` in temp CODEX_HOME wrote config.toml `[marketplaces.context-mode] source_type="git" source="https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode.git"` (no ref). cm-main .agents/plugins/marketplace.json plugins[0].source = {"source":"url","url":"./"}. Commit 1e73a13d body: Codex reads `[.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json]` (marketplace.rs:21). spike-distribution-verified.md:14 verified only a fresh add with `--ref release`. The live upgrade with a local remote could not run: codex rejected file:// and git:// sources, so the post-upgrade state is inferred from code, not observed.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 1e73a13d 2026-05-11 'fix(codex): make plugin discoverable via .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (#525)'; later b4b1e44a 2026-06-01 (#748). ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'context-mode never shows up in Codex CLI's /plugin listing despite shipping a .codex-plugin/marketplace.json'. REGRESSION_RISK: dropping or ignoring this file re-breaks #525 discovery. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep .agents/plugins/marketplace.json on main and point its source at the release ref.
findings.fix: Add to step b: on main also edit .agents/plugins/marketplace.json plugins[0].source to the github repo with ref release. Test from an EXISTING v1 Codex install (no ref), not a clean CODEX_HOME. findings.claim: Deleting tmp files `context-mode-*` mid-upgrade breaks a still-running v1 session: v1 hooks find the MCP server by scanning /tmp/context-mode-mcp-ready-<pid>. Other v1 tmp names (cm-fs-preload-<pid>.js, ctx-fetch-*.dat, ctx-upgrade-*) do not match the glob.
findings.evidence: Live: one v1 start.mjs run left /tmp/context-mode-mcp-ready-<pid> files. cm-main src/server.ts:4861 'Hardcoded /tmp on Unix to avoid TMPDIR mismatch (#347)'; hooks/core/mcp-ready.mjs:12 'Scan: glob all context-mode-mcp-ready-* files, probe each PID'; server.ts:426 cm-fs-preload-, :3317 ctx-fetch-, :4355 ctx-upgrade-.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 04569b12 2026-04-13 'fix: graceful MCP redirect fallback via readiness sentinel (#230)', path fix #347. REGRESSION_RISK: removing a live sentinel makes v1 hooks treat the MCP server as down. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: delete only when the PID is dead (process.kill(pid,0)), look in /tmp and os.tmpdir().
findings.fix: Rule: delete a sentinel only when its PID is dead; list the four exact tmp prefixes and both dirs (/tmp and os.tmpdir()).

findings.claim: The npm order (uninstall -g first, then git install) puts the user in a known broken window: line 76 admits Copilot CLI, VS Code and Codex hooks fail until cleanup. An order exists that keeps the user working at every step.
findings.evidence: ADR-0011:76 'After npm uninstall -g, these hooks fail until the cleanup runs.' cm-main configs/codex/hooks.json command 'context-mode hook codex pretooluse' (global bin).
findings.fix: Order per agent: 1) install v2 by the git/marketplace path; 2) restart and run ctx_upgrade, which removes v1 entries; 3) restart; 4) ctx_doctor D4 shows zero v1 findings; 5) only then `npm uninstall -g context-mode`. Add a test that Codex accepts a v1 [mcp_servers.context-mode] and the v2 plugin MCP at once (unverified).
